Web Push encryption is bundled, without modification, from
`@block65/webcrypto-web-push@2.0.0` and `uint8array-extras@1.6.0`.
Both are MIT licensed; their notices are retained alongside this bundle.

Upstream: https://github.com/block65/webcrypto-web-push

Rebuild with esbuild (ES2022, neutral platform, ESM, bundled) using the package's
`dist/lib/main.js` entry. Only the resulting module and license notices belong
in this repository. No runtime credentials or subscription data are included.
